# Static-content starter: native task follow-up

Continuation of the [starter implementation and failed acquisitions](2026-09-16-static-content-starter.md).
This records local `go-web` evidence, not server-free static delivery, consumer
adoption or full quality certification. Original failures and budgets stay intact.

## Input diagnosis and harness repair

The first per-key trace established premature Enter submission, not a general native
select limitation. A separate two-case diagnostic used native full-label typeahead,
then Tab to the submit button and Enter. Both `empty` (200) and `unavailable` (503)
retained the initial URL until submission and sent the correct state/theme query.
The application and JavaScript-disabled condition were unchanged.

Diagnostic root:
`/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-static-content-bk2nf9/select-typeahead-diagnostic-K5frBo`.
Its `select-diagnostic-receipt.json` has SHA-256
`eead46658dd41b18e3ffe09ae0da534efafdac156eb47e5857eca9d174d2ceac`.
All eight requests were admitted; both processes exited 0 with no signal and port
50945 returned `ECONNREFUSED`. This diagnostic is not a performance observation.

The acceptance harness now requires the exact form submit button, exact selected
value and explicit absence of navigation before submitting. The navigation listener
also detects same-URL reloads. Failure receipts retain actual selection/focus/URL
facts and screenshots. An armed navigation wait handles rejection immediately.
Sixteen pure canaries pass, including missing navigation evidence and wrong-button
refusal. Required tasks, rendering, input modality and numeric budgets are unchanged.

## Fixed-identity refusal repair

The Gallery-owned model previously admitted content IDs that collided with its
fixed FAQ heading, state control and surrounding shell. The reservation set now
includes `content-faq-heading`, `content-state`, `gallery-main` and
`gallery-navigation`. Default content/markup and public APIs are unchanged.

Negative tests reproduced three collisions before repair. Retained proof under
`/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-static-content-validation-evidence/`:

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `red-before-reserve.txt` | `96597158b998a369cff8f670f2440681d7199bd679573bd627432cee40671496` |
| `green-after-reserve.txt` | `ef8e4d2af63251942e7baaad2daa99591399042cc69a9c25960ed6dc2331b7db` |

The intermediate red test's source bytes were not retained, only its hash/log. That
log is diagnostic, not replayable acceptance evidence; [INC-43](../intent/incidents.md)
records the retention gap. The final source/test snapshot below does not recover it.

A further full-page drift test requires HTTP 200, nonempty and unique rendered IDs,
and reservation of every fixed ID outside the model. An initial test-only compile
mistake treated the HTTP response as a status integer; corrected before the green
run. Focused tests pass (0.442s); the prepared build below includes this final test.

## Browser acquisition

The acquisition at
`/Volumes/m2ext/appkit-evidence/appkit-static-content-gVEUw4/static-content-BWBGc5` passes its
bounded contract: four lanes, 52 document observations, 104 admitted requests,
60 retained captures and zero failures. All 60 capture hashes were independently
rechecked against the receipt. The exact executable matches the fresh build above.

| Retained input | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `receipt.json` | `2414d8e1768d971b5d1c6db679fbcdc8f60f736d90f3f3236427d94644767075` |
| Executed `probe.mjs` | `036e61ec985ef06b83f1b9441d01552a7ca5c820aea56b82da8bbd665b3c16bb` |
| `run-config.json` | `3aa9838d5b65c32199922d6eb349a7c651c07cfa83164852fc06651128b5d574` |

Chrome 152.0.7977.84 uses fresh isolated contexts, no page JavaScript, no service
workers, disabled cache, reduced motion and unthrottled owned loopback HTTP. Each
390×1000 and 1440×1000 light/dark lane covers reading, native outline focus,
independent keyboard/pointer FAQ disclosure, article navigation and browser Back;
empty/unavailable native selection, theme switching and reset; and 404 recovery.
All eight state-selection receipts require exact selected value, exact submit-button
focus and no navigation before button activation. Numeric observations bind actual
document/CSS response bodies, status, asset identity and navigation timing.

| Local observed maximum | Result | Fixed ceiling |
|---|---:|---:|
| Total decoded HTML + CSS per navigation | 72,984 bytes | 131,072 bytes |
| Response end | 24.5 ms | 100 ms |
| DOM content loaded | 33.6 ms | 250 ms |
| Load end | 56 ms | 500 ms |

Host checked immediately after acquisition: Mac16,10, Apple M4, 32 GiB RAM,
macOS 26.6.2 (`sw_vers`/`sysctl`). Measurements use browser Navigation Timing and
actual response bodies, not transfer-size guesses or production latency estimates.
Both browser and Gallery exit 0 without signals; port 53816 returns `ECONNREFUSED`.

Scoped visual review covers 12 distinct retained captures: six reading/article/focus
views and six independently reviewed empty/unavailable/unknown/recovered views,
including narrow/wide and light/dark examples. No clipping, unreadable state copy or
recovery-layout blocker was observed; focus outlines are visibly painted in the
reviewed focus images. This is not a review of all 60 images or measured contrast.

## Remaining acceptance

Actual zoom, assistive technology, comprehensive contrast, maximum/long content,
all capability-destination journeys, full cold/warm/degraded/input/memory budgets,
server-free static-host delivery and a real consumer upgrade remain open. This
passes the declared local browser task and numeric screen, not all converted-core-v1
standards or quality gates. No target certification, installed-host upgrade, public
API, dependency, consumer, deployment or theme-default change is implied.
